name: MyMemory Translation API
summary: Free translation-memory lookup and machine translation for a segment, with a daily character quota.
description: MyMemory matches a text segment against a large translation memory of human and machine translations and returns the best translation plus ranked matches with quality and usage counts. Language pairs use langpair=src|target codes. Anonymous use is capped per day; passing an email raises the cap.

auth.notes: No key needed. An optional valid email in the de parameter raises the daily quota.

rate_limit.summary: Anonymous: 5,000 characters per day; with a valid email in the de parameter: 50,000 characters per day (usage-limits page). Counted in characters, not requests.

endpoints.summary: Translate or look up a segment

license.name: Translation memory under the MyMemory terms of service

agent_notes: langpair is source|target; percent-encode the pipe as %7C. Check responseStatus inside the body, and quotaFinished for the daily cap (a quota failure can come back as HTTP 200 with an error message in translatedText). matches[] lists alternatives with a quality score.
caveats: The HTTP status can be 200 while responseStatus signals an error or exhausted quota.
A 500 was seen once on the specification page during checks; the API itself answered 200.
Match quality varies: human memory entries mix with machine output.

verification.notes: Exact example executed without a key or email.
